from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial metric found in a company report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company filing the report")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the financial figure corresponds to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific financial line item name, e.g. 'Total Assets'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the line item")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency or scale, e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short excerpt from the document showing the figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_line_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
